card.name: Quantifier before indications or populations
card.fires_on: Words like several, all, other, multiple or by that come right after across, in or vary and lead into indications, trials, populations or tumor types in drug-label text.

modes.label: Scope words after across
modes.description: A quantifier such as several, all or multiple follows across and introduces the range of indications, trials or populations.
